title: Ecosystem Config
description: Structural contract for the ecosystem project and deployment registry. Cross-record rules (unique hostnames, unique deployment names, meaningful strings, career ids, dates and ordering) are enforced by scripts/validate.mjs.

username.description: must be a GitHub username (letters, digits and '-')

profile.description: Personal profile of the owner. Optional; additive to the top-level fields.

title.description: Professional title, e.g. a job role. Optional.

links.description: Canonical social links keyed by platform (e.g. github, linkedin, website). Any key is allowed; values must be absolute HTTPS URLs.

assets.description: Local profile assets under assets/profile/ (checked by scripts/validate.mjs).

ecosystem.description: Shared ecosystem brand identity, separate from the personal profile. Optional.

assets.description: Local ecosystem brand assets under assets/ecosystem/ (checked by scripts/validate.mjs).

career.description: Career collections (experience, freelance, assessments). Always present; each collection may be empty.

careerPublication.description: Optional independent Gateway Career permissions. Absence denies all publication; listing alone never approves content.

origins.description: Origins archive: curated early-development entries. Always present; may be empty.

concepts.description: Concepts: future project ideas (titles only). Always present; may be empty.

email.description: must be a valid email address (local@domain.tld, no spaces, no leading, trailing or repeated dots in the local part)

domain.description: must be a lowercase domain with at least two DNS labels, e.g. example.com
